recorded.prompt:q-cover-row: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-cover-row: A set $`C \subseteq I`$ is a **cover** of the row when its weights add up to more than the capacity ... So every whole plan takes at most $`|C| - 1`$ of them
recorded.prompt:q-extension: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-extension: Let $`a_{\max}`$ be the largest weight in a cover $`C`$. Any item $`j`$ outside $`C`$ with $`a_j \ge a_{\max}`$ can join the left side with the right side unchanged
recorded.prompt:q-broken: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-broken: An LP point $`x^*`$ breaks it exactly when $`\sum_{i \in C} (1 - x^*_i) < 1`$.

recorded.prompt:q-cover-row:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover-row:b: A cover needs weights that "add up to more than the capacity"; a, b and d weigh exactly 8.
recorded.prompt:q-cover-row:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover-row:c: The cover row is $`\le |C| - 1`$ = 2. A right side of 1 refuses a and b together (weight 7, which fits), so it is not valid.
recorded.prompt:q-cover-row:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cover-row:d: a and d weigh 5, not "more than the capacity" 8, so they are not a cover.
